context_requirements: Expression of ENTPD3 (CD39L3) in the assayed cell line
Dependence of the measured transcriptional state on extracellular nucleotide/nucleoside balance
Adenosine-receptor or purinergic signaling tone sufficient to couple ENTPD3 activity to transcription
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes that are reversed by ENTPD3-selective inhibition or genetic ENTPD3 perturbation
